brief.prose: After the captain completes Wide first, then close, Qureshi offers an optional follow-up about real paid survey work. Any available commission can count; the finite shared board, funding, sounding coverage, payment and standing keep their ordinary rules. The quest verifies fresh completion and payment before recording its separate once-only personal relationship bonus. It never allocates a commission or discloses the captain's chart.

def.title: Work worth signing
def.introduction: You have tried the broad reading and the closer one. A commission asks a different question: can someone depend on you to finish the whole block? If that work suits your plans, look at Occator's board and choose any available commission. I will be here to hear how it went. Take this invitation before you finish the block; work already underway can count. The board is shared, and this conversation reserves nothing. You can take commissions without my invitation, too.

checkpoints.title: Complete a survey commission and receive its payment
checkpoints.instructions: Read +survey and +survey <id>. Choose any available commission; +survey/accept <id> previews and +survey/accept <id> go files it. Wait for funding, then complete fresh soundings across all 256 pockets of its block within seven IC days. help mining explains coverage, quiet soundings and equipment; plan your route and provisions. An unfinished commission can already exist when you accept this invitation. After completion and payment, return to the Exchange: +quest/check Rosalind=tacsim.quests.survey_work/quest.qureshi_signed_work, then +quest/finish Rosalind=tacsim.quests.survey_work/quest.qureshi_signed_work. Your chart stays private. Occator pays the ordinary reward; this invitation adds only my personal relationship bonus. Abandoning it does not cancel a commission.

def.completion: After our first readings, the captain completed a real survey commission, received its payment and returned to the Exchange. They followed the block through to the end. I can credit that work without taking their private chart.
